items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) officially ACTIVE for Giants SNF vs Cowboys after murky up-to-him status and PS elevations.
items.why: Knee cleared late; coach previously non-committal but activated.
items.implication: Start everywhere despite decoy risk; high upside WR1.
items.opportunity: Primary target share if full go; monitor early usage.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) officially ACTIVE for Bears Week 1 vs Panthers after expected-to-play reports.
items.why: Calf injury cleared for full participation and activation.
items.implication: Start in all formats as primary WR option.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected in Bears offense.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and later confirmed ACTIVE for Cardinals Week 1 vs Chargers.
items.why: Weekend reports and beat confirmation of expected availability after ankle sprain; officially active.
items.implication: Start-worthy risk/reward RB2 in most formats if snaps materialize.
items.opportunity: Featured rookie role possible with full go; monitor snap share and goal-line.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) not expected to play Week 1 vs Lions despite late full participation; questionable but sidelined.
items.why: Sources indicate not quite ready after MCL sprain.
items.implication: Sit Kamara; elevates NO backfield alternatives.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes for Travis Etienne and committee mates.

items.text: Post-game injury watch: Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Ladd McConkey (chest) left early; also tracking BTJ shoulder, Murray concussion, Lane wrist etc. Kamara absence impacts Etienne projections.
items.why: In-game exits observed; severity TBD for next week.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 status; potential sits or limits.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup elevation if multi-week; Etienne boost already from Kamara.

items.text: Malik Nabers ACTIVE: starting wherever rostered despite decoy risk post-knee uncertainty.
items.why: Activation after murky reports; elite talent overrides decoy fear.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT with wrist injury (initial fracture diagnosis, further MRI); several weeks expected.
items.why: Wrist injury in game; sources confirm fracture concerns and multi-week absence.
items.implication: Remove from waivers/lineups; monitor return timeline.
items.opportunity: Slight bump to other Ravens WRs if Flowers also limited.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere; team wouldn't activate if major injury concern (Cardinals caveat).
items.why: Activation signals confidence post-ankle; preseason hype intact.
items.implication: Must-start in most leagues as RB2 with upside.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back snaps/carries if healthy.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) OUT Week 1 vs Dolphins; realistic chance return Week 2 vs Chargers after procedure.
items.why: Meniscus trim Tuesday; short-term absence expected 1-2 weeks.
items.implication: Sit Week 1; stash for potential quick return. TE premium hit.
items.opportunity: Expanded role for Michael Mayer as primary TE.

items.text: AJ Brown (high ankle sprain) expected out ~6 weeks, no surgery; placed on IR (min 4 weeks). More serious end of 4-6 range.
items.why: High ankle from Week 1 opener; IR designation and insider timeline.
items.implication: Long-term sit/IR stash; NE WR depth elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Patriots receivers.

items.text: Main slate news locked; only major proj change expected from Malik Nabers (Q knee) news. Situation murky/up-to-him with PS elevations (Berrios/Cambre). Combined injury wave note including Bowers/AJB.
items.why: Pre-activation uncertainty; projections live and updating; unclean injury start to season.
items.implication: Monitor for final status before lock; no other major proj shifts.
items.opportunity: If out, Giants WR elevations; overall slate injury chaos.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1 showing.
items.why: Post-game production signals expanded TE role in Ravens offense.
items.implication: Buy/start as TE1 upside with Andrews/others.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason belief in Bears offense volume unchanged despite Week 1 quietude (Kmet/Raymond targets).
items.why: Wants Bears offense exposure; Week 1 not indicative of role.
items.implication: Hold/buy for TE upside in high-powered attack.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks role more real than not after preseason hype with new OC Sean Mannion (from Packers).
items.why: Preseason discussion validated by early usage signals.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets in new scheme.
